column1: # Every defaulting adaptor applied to a read, as found by
# tests/a_failed_read_is_not_defaulted_into_a_fact.rs, and what a person who read it
# decided. Columns (tab-separated): class, file, enclosing fn, kind, source text.
# A row is a decision about one site, made by reading it. It is not a place to
# put a defect: those are fixed, or recorded as `tracked:TD-n` with the evidence
# in docs/TECH_DEBT.md. The gate fails on a hit with no row and on a row that
# matches nothing, so a fix that removes a site must remove its row, and an edit
# that changes a site's text must re-read it.
# Classes are defined in the test (CLASSES). In short:
#   handled          the error is kept: logged and shown, or the caller refuses
#   decoration       the default states nothing about the station
#   not-a-read       the fallible step is a conversion, a clock, a file or a task
#   fail-closed      the default is the safe side
#   setting-default  a setting falling back to its documented default
#   omitted          the series or section is left out, not printed as zero
#   task-panic       a task that panicked, not a query that failed
#   write-outcome    the outcome is carried on another path
#   cache            an optimisation whose failure is inert
#   tracked:TD-n     known, evidenced, not fixed; see docs/TECH_DEBT.md
